verdict.rationale: Temporal explicitly documents Signals/Updates for external input, durable state that survives multi-day waits, and directly states workflows resume after 'a multi-day wait for a human to approve a step' (temporal-docs-41, temporal-docs-6, temporal-docs-38, temporal-docs-9). Community evidence corroborates long-running, stateful workflow execution in production use. missing for 10: no hands-on/independent case study specifically demonstrating a human-approval pause-and-resume in production, and no mention of timeout/escalation handling for indefinite waits.
